objects: one owned Ring emblem per player
captured inherent ability and delayed trigger sources
events: one completed temptation with distinct chosen and retained bearer roles
each new blocking creature including put-blocking
actual bearer combat damage to a player
state_reads: emblem ability level capped at four
current blocker controller at sacrifice resolution
state_writes: canonical draw, discard, life loss and sacrifice results
costs: the keyword action itself has no cost
observer payment clauses use the existing fixed optional cost owner
timing: emblem progress precedes the required creature choice
an impossible choice still completes the temptation
choosing an existing bearer is still a choice
inherent triggers lock occurrence facts and controller
a skipped end-of-combat step does not expire the waiting sacrifice trigger
targets: an enclosing spell with all targets illegal does not execute the temptation
choices: choose exactly one current controlled creature when available
creature ownership is independent from its controller
the attack trigger uses the resolving controller's private discard choice
hidden_information: emblem progress and bearer choice are public
draw and discard choices retain principal-scoped hidden information
apnap: inherent and observer abilities enter the existing shared pending trigger batches
layers: the emblem supplies legendary in layer four through a live source-bearer relation
the greater-power restriction is external to the bearer's own abilities
replacement_effects: draw, damage and sacrifice delegate to the existing canonical owners and their represented replacements
copy: the designation is not a copiable characteristic
copied inherent abilities retain their original emblem source and bind you or opponents to the copy controller
control_change: control discontinuity ends the designation even if the creature returns to its former controller
phasing, untapping and ceasing to be a creature preserve designation
the delayed sacrifice uses the blocker's current controller
zone_change: a returned creature is a new incarnation and does not regain its earlier designation
the delayed sacrifice never follows a returned blocker incarnation
source_leaves: captured emblem source information survives pending ability and delay serialization

rulings: The pinned Call of the Ring rulings distinguish an impossible temptation from an actual bearer choice.
Rechoosing the current bearer satisfies choice observers.
The pinned Flash Foliage rulings distinguish put-blocking from declaring a blocker and retain becomes-blocked-by-creature triggers.

implementation.component: quorune.ring_model, ring_state, ring_effects, ring_triggers, ring_delays, typed Ring choice/intents and source-spanned compiler productions

known_blockers: Ring-bearer and lifetime-temptation conditions embedded in broader Oracle result grammar are not generally compiled.
Modified action instructions and player-qualified observer forms outside the closed controller productions remain residual.
